race.comment: SATIN SERENADE (14) was narrowly denied on debut behind her stablemate before spelling. Resumes off a short break and has trialled sharply in two with J Mac partnering both. Expect her to have her blending in beautifully at just the right time. Stablemate DEFENSEMEN (1) should be at his top third-up after just missing the bob at Randwick last time. Drops back slightly in trip off 39 days but has been kept up to the mark with a trial. Grima's 2ks claim gets him in well. No reason he can't salute this time. QUEEN'S GAMBLE (13) has hit the line nicely in both runs back but will be hoping the pace is strong so she can launch late from a poor draw. Berry will have to make sure he doesn't press the button too late. COMANCHE CHIEF (3) chased gamely into the placings on debut at Wyong and is in the mix if he's taken improvement. Similar for STATEROOM (8).
